messages:
maria_ng: FYI, bringing up hf/model-x on Redwood convert pipeline and hitting a weird token mapping bug. spm vocab has an empty piece entry which ends up creating an extra token id -> downstream ids shift.

devon_k: ugh. empty piece as in SentencePiece produced a zero-length piece in the vocab file? can you paste the top of the vocab and the mapping you saw?

maria_ng: yeah. from the model files: `vocab.spm` text dump shows line 42 is empty string (just a newline) between two real pieces. when we run our spm-to-bpe conversion script it treats that as a real token id 42.

maria_ng: snippet:```
# vocab.spm excerpt
40 \u2581the
41 \u2581and
42 
43 \u2581to
44 \u2581of
```

shan_li: whoa. that will definitely shift ids after 42. our conversion assumes contiguous non-empty pieces. did the original HF model ship a `tokenizer.json` that contradicts this?

maria_ng: tokenizer.json exists and its `vocab` array mirrors the spm file (including the empty string). hf tokenizer object returns token id 42 for "" which is unexpected.

devon_k: two issues to consider: 1) special token placements (e.g.,  token id offset) 2) chat templates that rely on known special token ids ( system/user/assistant ) will break if ids move.

qa_jen: observed a quality regression on the smoke evals after conversion: prompts with system instructions occasionally truncate or swap roles mid-output. BLEU down ~1.8 and some examples with repeated prefixes.

eval-bot: Regression alert: eval-suite/model-x/smoke: metric_delta: { "instr_adherence": -0.06, "dup_rate": +0.12 }

maria_ng: repro log attached: model outputs include leading `</s>` in the middle of a reply for some chats. hypothesis: our chat template mapping expects  special token id 2 but because of the empty piece, that id is now 3.

devon_k: quick mitigation: on conversion, filter-out zero-length pieces and then reindex vocab. But be careful: HF tokenizer objects may still reference the empty piece in special_tokens_map. Need to normalize special tokens by string match rather than id.

shan_li: we also saw cases where the empty piece acted like a placeholder for the PAD token in some HF exports. so blindly removing it might shift expected PAD id. add an explicit pass: if empty piece present and there is explicit pad/special token in tokenizer.json, remap that special token string to the intended id after cleaning.

maria_ng: patch I ran: `python tools/convert_spm.py --in vocab.spm --out vocab.bpe --drop-empty --remap-specials special_tokens.json` produced clean mapping and smoke tests recovered most cases. local perf: latency same, quality back to baseline on 90% of tests.

devon_k: can you paste the fix diff? will add tests.

maria_ng: diff gist:```diff
- # naive index assignment
- for i, piece in enumerate(vocab):
-     id_map[piece] = i
+ # filter empty pieces then build map preserving declared specials
+ filtered = [p for p in vocab if p != ""]
+ # ensure specials are reinserted at their declared ids if present in tokenizer.json
+ filtered = insert_specials_at_declared_ids(filtered, special_tokens_json)
+ for i, piece in enumerate(filtered):
+     id_map[piece] = i
```

qa_jen: added an integration case: model onboarding should fail if spm contains empty pieces unless there's an explicit justification in metadata. created ticket INF-1129.

shan_li: also needed to tweak chat template loader: resolve special tokens by string first (e.g., "<|system|>") then fall back to id. that prevents silent misbindings.

devon_k: note for quantization experiments: if you change id ordering after quantizing weight tied embeddings to token ids, you must rebuild embedding table ordering or model will serve wrong tokens. include that in release notes.

maria_ng: good point. I verified re-ordered embeddings were rebuilt in the pipeline step; otherwise nonsense.

qa_jen: tests: added small unit to simulate `vocab.spm` with inserted empty piece and assert conversion produces stable special token indices and that chat template tokens remain consistent.

maria_ng: thanks. rolling the patch to staging now. cc @eng-oncall if anything noisy shows up. :thumbsup:

devon_k: awesome. follow-up: audit other HF vendors for similar empty-piece cases — might be more common than we thought.

shan_li: I ran a quick grep across onboarding bucket: found 3 other models with blank lines in spm files. filing followups.

maria_ng: thread summary: empty spm piece caused id shift -> special token/chat template mismatch -> quality regressions. Fix: drop empty pieces, remap specials by string and reindex, rebuild/tie embeddings accordingly, add gating test.

qa_jen: INF-1129 created, PR#548 linked to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
